column1: # Top-level-test shards of internal/workerservice for integration CI (CHAOS-9060).
# One `go test` of this package took 24 of the 25 minutes of its job on the
# hosted runner (main 20.5-21 min, a head with 19 more tests 23m56s and then a
# cancelled job), so a merge would leave the shard red at random. ci/check_go.sh
# therefore runs the package ONLY as these name-partitioned shards (the same
# mechanism as go_daily_test_shards.tsv) and never in the `packages` target.
# Every discovered top-level test lands in exactly one shard.
# Weights are relative classes (integration-tagged vs ordinary), not seconds.
